named_premises: God-enabled capacity, personal authorship, and actual acceptance/refusal alternatives under the same complete antecedents; no self-supplied restoration.
soundness.denial_cost: The native genuinely-refusable response account must be replaced or weakened. A deterministic/compatibilist account can keep permitted choices while denying identical-antecedent alternatives; A0 alone is not contradicted.

obstructions.reason: Two permitted branches do not prove actual freedom. This is what the framework goes by, openly admitted; denial changes the native freedom account rather than refuting A0.
